guide.echoes_fireforge.forge.compressed_:
Deep in the Nether, near the ancient debris, lie even rarer blocks: machines crushed by time.

They never touch the air: you have to dig for them. The larger veins hide between Y 8 and 24. Needs at least a diamond pickaxe; with Silk Touch, you keep the block.
Mined, it drops one random part: a gear, a valve or an engraved plate. The forge and its modules are made of them.

Sometimes a machine also holds a plan engraved on brass. The Forge Plan lets you build it; the Stoker's Plans, numbered I to V, describe their craft.

Right-click to decipher a plan: it is not consumed. Each plan read improves the forge's odds a little, and wakes a page of the Stokers' Notebooks.
A forge two blocks long, built from the Forge Plan (consumed when crafted).

At the front, the hearth and the bellows; on top, the anvil showing the item being worked; behind, the chimney. Right-click to open it.
guide.echoes_fireforge.forge.reforging.p:
Reforgeable: swords, axes, armor, shield, bows, crossbows, tridents and maces.

The forge alone holds one bucket of water. Water and fuel can come in through hoppers (fuel from the top, water from the sides); empty buckets and bottles leave through the bottom.

The forge is sealed: it also works in the Nether.
guide.echoes_fireforge.forge.heat.title: Heat
guide.echoes_fireforge.forge.rarities.p2:
Percentages apply to the item's own values: damage, attack speed, reach, knockback for weapons; armor, toughness, knockback resistance, speed and fire resistance for armor; arrow damage, draw or reload speed and arrow speed for bows and crossbows.

The odds are shown in the interface. The rarity survives enchanting and the netherite upgrade.
guide.echoes_fireforge.forge.cracks.p2:
When it cracks, you have a second and a half to work the bellows, in the interface or with a right-click on the forge. Success clears the risk; a miss means the item comes out Cracked.

The bellows blow steam: a puff at nothing costs a little water.

Cracked does not damage the item: just a malus.
guide.echoes_fireforge.forge.modules.p1:
Against the left side of the hearth, the boiler enlarges the water reserve: 4 buckets per block, stackable 3 blocks high.

Fill it with a bucket or bottle by right-clicking, or with pipes. Sealed as well, it works in the Nether.
guide.echoes_fireforge.forge.modules.p3:
Behind the forge, the lava tank feeds Furnace heat: 5 buckets per block, 2 blocks high.

It is only used when the fuel slot is empty: placed fuel always comes first.

Breaking a module shrinks the reserve, and the excess leaves as steam or smoke.
guide.echoes_fireforge.forge.specials.p1:
A Special only comes at Furnace heat. Each one comes from a Stoker machine, and has its drawback.

Weapons (sword, axe): Valve, Steam Hammer, Building Pressure.

Armor: Boiler (chestplate), Founder's Stride (leggings), Bellows (boots), Stoker's Goggles (helmet), Ash Shroud (any piece).
guide.echoes_fireforge.forge.specials.p2:
The exact effect and drawback are shown in the item's tooltip.

Bows, crossbows, tridents, maces and shields have no Special at a normal fire: a Special roll becomes Stoked.
guide.echoes_fireforge.forge.soul_module:
Against the right side of the forge, the soul module offers a choice of fire at each reforge.

At the soul fire, the hearth turns blue: 10 souls per reforge, never a crack, but all or nothing. Specials there come from a list of their own, the Watchers' list.

Sword, axe: Watchers' Blade, Blade Echo; axe only: Rootcleaver. Bow: Singing String. Crossbow: Silent Bolt. Trident: River Harpoon. Mace: Knell.

Helmet: Watcher's Gaze. Chestplate: Sealed Urn. Boots: Muffled Step.

Some cost souls each time they act.
guide.echoes_fireforge.plans.forge.title: The Forge Plan
guide.echoes_fireforge.plans.forge.p1:
Two hearths under a single chimney. The line is sure and firm, engraved by someone who had built a hundred.

In the margin, a smaller line: "Water first. Fire second. Never the other way."
guide.echoes_fireforge.plans.1.title: The Fires
guide.echoes_fireforge.plans.1.p1:
Five fires, from the gentlest to the strongest. Wood is marked with one stroke, lava with five.

"Metal takes only what the fire gives it. Whoever wants more must burn hotter."
guide.echoes_fireforge.plans.2.title: Steam
guide.echoes_fireforge.plans.2.p1:
A boiler, in cross-section. Arrows rise from the hearth to the ceiling, and pass through it.

Below, scratched out then engraved again: "We always need more. The water leaves faster than we pour it."
guide.echoes_fireforge.plans.3.title: The Bellows
guide.echoes_fireforge.plans.3.p1:
Metals in a column, each with its heat mark. Beyond it, a crack drawn in a single stroke.

"When the metal cries out, blow. The steam calms it. Whoever hesitates keeps the scar."
guide.echoes_fireforge.plans.4.title: The Offering
guide.echoes_fireforge.plans.4.p1:
An outstretched hand above a hearth. In the palm, something small and precious.

"The fire returns what it is given. Sometimes, it returns more."
guide.echoes_fireforge.plans.5.title: The Last Lines
guide.echoes_fireforge.plans.5.p1:
The line trembles; the plan stops there.

"The elders cough ash. Some blame the smoke of the machines; others say it was here before us."
guide.echoes_fireforge.intro:
These pages gather what Echoes of the Fire Forge adds: the compressed machine, the forge and its modules, rarities and Specials.

The Stokers' Notebooks reveal themselves as you decipher their plans.
guide.echoes_fireforge.cat.forge.desc: The Stokers turned the Nether into a forge-world. Their machines still sleep under the rock, and their forge can live again.
guide.echoes_fireforge.cat.plans.desc:
The Stokers' plans, engraved on brass and found in compressed machines.

The erased pages are waiting to be found.
